Proposed Sales Deck contents

Selling something you have to answer these questions

Product and Revenue
1) what is your product
2) why is it different from everyone else
3) why will people want it?
4) how do you make money?
5) what is your future plans?

Investor
6) how will it make me money?
7) how long will I take to breakeven?
8) what is my Return of Investment beyond breakeven?
9) do you intend to sell the company (exit strategy)
10) what is my risk? 
11) what is my stop losses (in event of liquidation) (ONLY if they ask)

Company
12) why your company
13) what is your track record
14) where are you from?
15) what is a dao and why this structure.
